entities.description: A weathered wooden counter with a blue-painted front panel that is peeling and chipped, revealing the lighter wood underneath. The top surface is a worn, light-colored wood with visible grain and scratches, holding a white plate of bread rolls, a red plastic basket, and several glasses and bottles.
A beige curtain with a repeating pattern of red flowers and green leaves hangs from a rod, featuring a slightly wrinkled texture and a small white tag on the right side.

A long, floor-length curtain hangs in a gathered, pleated style from a rod, featuring a beige or cream background with a repeating pattern of large, rust-red floral motifs and smaller brownish leaves. The fabric appears to be a lightweight material, possibly cotton or a blend, and is suspended by hooks or rings that create deep vertical folds.
A beige curtain with a repeating pattern of red and brown floral motifs hangs in vertical folds behind a man, gathered at the top by a rod.

A smiling woman with dark hair and medium skin tone stands behind a blue wooden counter, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a bright red headscarf that drapes over her shoulders. She rests one hand on the counter next to a red plastic colander, with a man in a plaid shirt partially visible to her left.

entities.description: A young boy with short black hair and a serious expression sits at a counter, wearing a dark blue t-shirt with a white graphic design and blue jeans. He is positioned in profile, looking directly at the camera with his hands resting on his lap and the counter surface.

A middle-aged man with tanned skin and a serious expression sits on a wooden chair, wearing a brown wide-brimmed hat, a red vest over a blue denim jacket, and blue jeans. He is positioned in the foreground, looking directly at the camera with one hand raised near his collar.

A middle-aged man with short black hair and a mustache is shown from the chest up, wearing a dark plaid button-down shirt with a pocket on the left chest. He holds a black microphone in his right hand, looking slightly to the side with a neutral expression, while a white ceramic teapot sits in the foreground and a person wearing a red headscarf is partially visible to his right.

A middle-aged man with short dark hair and a mustache stands facing the camera, wearing a green and white striped polo shirt and a white apron. He has a slight smile and is positioned behind a table with a green thermos and a glass bottle of dark soda.
